name: consolidate-git-invocation
title: Consolidate git invocation into shared lib (A-076)
description: Route every script's git invocation through the shared library so no script builds a git environment of its own (AC4 of parent 07-28-consolidate-shared-script-helpers). Requires a minimal, prompt-disabled, cache-independent, bytes-capable lib git path before migrating the review-local and surface-check bypasses.
